description.zh: 修改后的描述。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。
description.en: The new description of the snapshot-consistent group. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: 修改后的快照一致性组名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头，可以包含数字、英文句号（.）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）或者半角冒号（:）。
description.en: The new name of the snapshot-consistent group. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. The name must start with a letter and cannot start with a `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), hyphens (-), and colons (:).

description.zh: 快照一致性组所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the snapshot-consistent group. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 快照一致性组ID。您可以调用[DescribeSnapshotGroups](~~210940~~)查询快照一致性组ID。
description.en: The ID of the snapshot-consistent group. You can call the [DescribeSnapshotGroups](~~210940~~) operation to query the IDs of available snapshot-consistent groups.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs modify-snapshot-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --snapshot-group-id ssg-j6ciyh3k52qp7ovm0000 --name testName02 --description This_is_new_description --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs ModifySnapshotGroup --region cn-hangzhou --Description This_is_new_description --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --SnapshotGroupId 'ssg-j6ciyh3k52qp7ovm0000' --Name testName02
